concerns.text: T013e (LLM Consensus Execution) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on the output of T013c (consensus_sample.json). The task description states 'This task runs AFTER T014' and reads artifacts from T013c. A task consuming an artifact cannot be parallel-safe with the producer of that artifact. The [P] tag is incorrect and creates a hidden ordering violation if executed in parallel.

T013f (Correction Factor Calculation) is marked [P] but depends on T013e (consensus_ground_truth.json) and T013 (flagged_pairs_count.json). The description explicitly states 'This task must run before T013d' and relies on the output of T013e. Marking it [P] implies it can run concurrently with its producers, violating the 'Producer before consumer' rule.

T013d (Aggregation of wasted call ratio) is marked [P] but has explicit dependencies on T013f (correction_factor.json) and T013a (total_budget). The description states 'Dep: T013f' and requires reading the correction factor. It cannot be parallel-safe with T013f.

T024a (Labeled Subset calculation) is marked [P] but depends on T013e (consensus_ground_truth.json). The description states 'Dep: T013e' and requires reading the ground truth to create embeddings. It cannot be parallel-safe with T013e.
T031 (Statistical Report Generation) is marked [P] but depends on T013d, T013f, and T030. The description explicitly lists 'Dep: T013d, T013f, T030'. It cannot be parallel-safe with these tasks.

T069 (Verify Proxy Validation Chain) is marked pending but has a dependency on T013d ('This task MUST run after T013d is complete'). If T013d is executed in a parallel batch (due to its [P] tag), T069 might start before T013d finishes, causing a race condition. The dependency chain T013e -> T013f -> T013d -> T069 must be strictly sequential, not parallel.
